trial_court: MM (NI Act)-03, Patiala House Courts, New Delhi, Criminal Complaint No. 14799/2019
case_name: Reena Singh vs M S Bhumi Sagar Infrastructure Pvt Ltd

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Reena Singh, wife of one of the Directors
parties.respondent_defendant: M S Bhumi Sagar Infrastructure Pvt Ltd

facts_of_case: Petitioner's husband resigned as a Director from M/s A and A Build Projects Pvt. Ltd. on 18.09.2019. The respondent filed a complaint under Section 138 NI Act for bouncing of cheque bearing No.009016 dated 20.09.2019 for an amount of Rs. 7.5 crores.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the complainant to prove that the cheque was dishonoured due to the drawer's negligence.
legal_principles.held: It is stated in the petition that the petitioner is neither the Director nor the signatory of M/s A and A Build Projects Pvt. Ltd.

legal_principles.principle: A person who is not a director or signatory of the company cannot be held liable for cheque bouncing.
legal_principles.held: The petitioner is neither the Director nor the signatory of M/s A and A Build Projects Pvt. Ltd.

outcome.final_order: Proceedings before the learned MM (NI Act)-03, Patiala House Courts, New Delhi are stayed till the next date of hearing and before the Revision Court bearing Revision No.89/2022 is also stayed till the next date of hearing.

use_for_drafting: drafting a petition for quashing of criminal complaint
advising on company law and director's resignation
representing clients in cheque bounce cases
